finding.root_cause: The prospective evaluator addressed catalogue sources through the historical comparison-record field `identifier`. The production public catalogue contains `SourceCandidate` records whose canonical field is `source_id`. Unit doubles repeated the historical field name, so focused tests and no-write preflight could not expose the public-schema mismatch.
finding.scientific_impact: none published: all 144 candidate products completed, but every pair stopped during post-candidate truth-linkage reduction before its coarse control, accepted observation, Dask comparison, aggregation, or atomic decision
finding.verification: An isolated execution of the first frozen development case reproduced the exact exception after candidate publication. After the test-first correction, the same case completed candidate and coarse-control execution and wrote attribution schema version 3 with one source in each result.
